definitions.gloss: used bookstore; secondhand bookshop; antiquarian bookshop
definitions.explanation: A store that sells used, secondhand, or rare and antique books. More formal and literary than the everyday term.

examples.japanese: {古書店|こしょてん}で{珍|めずら}しい{本|ほん}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a rare book at a used bookstore.

examples.japanese: {神保町|じんぼうちょう}には{多|おお}くの{古書店|こしょてん}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Many used bookstores line the streets of Jinbocho.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{古書店|こしょてん}をめぐって、{絶版|ぜっぱん}になった{小説|しょうせつ}を{探|さが}すのが{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: My hobby is visiting used bookstores on weekends to look for out-of-print novels.

notes:
A more formal or literary term for a used bookstore. {神保町|じんぼうちょう} in Tokyo is famous as Japan's largest district of {古書店|こしょてん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古書店|こしょてん}をめぐる — to visit used bookstores
- {古書店|こしょてん}{街|がい} — used bookstore district
- {古書店|こしょてん}で{買|か}う — to buy at a used bookstore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {古本屋|ふるほんや} — used bookstore; the everyday, casual equivalent
- {書店|しょてん} — bookstore (general, new books)
- {本屋|ほんや} — bookstore; casual everyday term
